chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Bawah Sadar yang Sering Membantah
side_a_text: Doamu tidak pernah ditolak semesta. Bawah sadarmu hanya mengabulkan apa yang paling kamu takuti, sebab itulah yang paling khusyuk kamu sembah.
visual_concept: Seorang pemuda duduk sendirian di meja kayu Bento Kopi Kaliurang saat senja gerimis; secangkir kopi hitam mengepul di depannya dengan pantulan jendela kaca basah, di mana bayangannya mengisyaratkan bobot batin yang tak tampak dari luar.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An introspective Indonesian man in his late 20s wearing an oversized olive cotton shirt * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Sitting alone at a weathered teak outdoor table of a rustic cafe along Jalan Kaliurang Yogyakarta during dusk, asphalt glistening from recent tropical rain, warm yellow string lights overhead * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Staring quietly down into a steaming black tubruk coffee in a clear glass, his face calm on the outside yet shadowed by an invisible weary weight * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] In the rain-streaked glass window behind him, his soft reflection subtly reveals an iceberg-like silhouette submerged under dark rippling water * [LIGHTING] Moody low-key cinematic lighting, amber tungsten glow from the cafe stall contrasting against deep twilight indigo sky * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Wet reclaimed teak wood grain, condensation droplets on glass, rough asphalt, analog 35mm film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 portrait composition, subject seated in lower third, generous quiet negative space in the upper twilight sky for editorial typography * [STYLE] Gritty contemporary Indonesian editorial photography, muted earthy palette of deep charcoal, amber, olive, and damp stone * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no floating symbols, no glowy magic orbs, no sci-fi holograms, no neon colors, no oversaturation.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib (book-pages.json page 16)
self_reflection_check: Pernah nggak kamu sangat ingin sesuatu, tapi begitu membayangkan benar-benar mendapatkannya malah muncul takut? Yang mana yang sebenarnya kamu percaya?
teaser: Kita bisa sangat ingin sesuatu, sambil diam-diam takut mendapatkannya. Siapa yang sebenarnya memegang kendali?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Asbak Penuh dan Kawan yang Tersesat
side_a_text: Waktu sakumu tebal kamu merasa menguasai dunia. Kamu baru ingat bersujud saat semesta meremukkan kesombonganmu menjadi debu.
visual_concept: Meja warkop sederhana di Yogyakarta tengah malam; asbak seng penuh puntung rokok kretek berasap tipis, dua cangkir kopi dingin, dan tangan seorang pria mencengkeram kepalanya dalam kelelahan sunyi, sementara di sampingnya buku catatan bersampul tebal teronggok kaku.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An exhausted young Indonesian man sitting across a weathered wooden table, resting his forehead against his folded hands * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] An open-air late-night roadside warkop in Yogyakarta, zinc roof, bare yellow bulb dangling overhead, quiet empty street behind * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Deep contemplative exhaustion and defeat, shoulders slumped, struggling to reconcile relentless effort with stagnant life * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] A crowded tin ashtray overflowing with burned kretek cigarette butts, where the faint curling smoke forms a subtle tight closed loop before dissipating * [LIGHTING] Single harsh overhead bulb casting deep dramatic shadows beneath the table, contrast between warm tungsten light and misty night shadow * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Scratched raw teak tabletop, dented tin ashtray, ash particles, paper notebook edges, gritty 35mm film texture * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 angle looking slightly down across the tabletop, subject in middle ground, clean dark negative space in upper third for text placement * [STYLE] Intimate documentary photography, muted earthy tones, deep charcoal black, warm ochre, cigarette ash grey * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no letters, no fantasy glow, no floating money, no motivational symbols, no surreal CGI.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Obrolan Bento Kopi & Titik Hancur Manusia (book-pages.json page 17)
self_reflection_check: Buku sudah dibaca. Seminar sudah didatangi. Video sudah ditonton. Tapi kok pas pulang, rasa cemasnya masih ikut naik motor?
teaser: Buku bertambah, seminar bertambah, doa bertambah. Tapi kalau takutnya masih sama, apa yang sebenarnya belum disentuh?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Ketika Semuanya Runtuh
side_a_text: Kamu menangisi istanamu yang terbakar, tanpa sadar api itu baru saja membakar penjara yang selama ini mengurungmu.
visual_concept: Seorang pria bersandar lemah di lantai ubin terakota dingin rumah tua Jawa di malam hari, bersandar pada pilar kayu jati lapuk; matanya terpejam melepas kelelahan ekstrem, di lantai tergeletak cangkir tanah liat retak yang melambangkan remuknya ego manusia.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A solitary Indonesian man in casual dark linen clothes sitting slumped on a cool floor, resting his back against a massive weathered wooden pillar * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Interior of a quiet traditional Javanese joglo house at midnight, terracotta tile floor, aged teak beams, unadorned and silent * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Surrender and physiological collapse after enduring severe prolonged stress, face drained of pride, releasing tension * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] A single cracked clay water cup on the floor beside him with water slowly seeping into the dry tile joint, symbolizing the cracked vessel of ego * [LIGHTING] Faint cool moonlight creeping through open wooden louvers, grazing his shoulder and leaving the room in gentle shadow * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Matte terracotta clay tiles, coarse raw teak grain, cracked earthenware, breathable cotton fabric, organic film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, subject anchored in the lower half of the frame, expansive dark upper ceiling rafters providing ample negative space * [STYLE] Poetic Indonesian cinema still, muted earthen hues, charcoal shadow, raw terracotta red, faded umber * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no halos, no bright neon aura, no angels or demons, no dramatic comic effects, no oversaturated lighting.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Pintu Spiritual Selalu Dimulai dari Kehancuran (book-pages.json page 18)
self_reflection_check: Waktu sedang jatuh, kadang kita nggak butuh orang yang paling pintar. Kita cuma butuh satu orang yang mau duduk dan nggak buru-buru ngomong.
teaser: Kadang pintu kesadaran justru terbuka ketika pegangan yang biasa kita andalkan satu per satu lepas.

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Penjaga Pintu yang Keras Kepala
side_a_text: Pintu gerbang pikiranmu menolak sejuta kata manis, tetapi ia tak berdaya di hadapan getaran rasa yang kamu sembunyikan di dada.
visual_concept: Seorang pria muda berdiri di kamar mandi temaram menatap bayangannya di cermin antik berbingkai kayu jati; tangannya memegang tepi wastafel keramik tua, di mana pantulan ekspresinya di cermin terlihat membawa keraguan dingin yang membantah senyum buatannya.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A young Indonesian man standing in front of a bathroom mirror, hands resting on the edge of an aged ceramic sink * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A dimly lit bathroom in a vintage colonial house, whitewashed crumbling plaster walls, a large bevelled teak-framed mirror * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Confronting his own reflection with intense scrutiny, catching the subtle split between outward composure and inner cynicism * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] His reflection in the antique glass appears slightly out of phase, with the mirrored face carrying a colder, knowing skepticism than the physical man * [LIGHTING] Single warm incandescent bulb above the mirror casting harsh split lighting across half of his face, leaving the background in darkness * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Aged mirror silvering blemishes, weathered teak wood, cold glazed ceramic, faded wall plaster, subtle 35mm grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 portrait orientation, mirror frame centered, head and torso occupying the middle third, quiet dark ceiling above * [STYLE] Psychological realism photography, muted vintage tone, desaturated olive, dark bone white, deep warm charcoal * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no split-personality monster faces, no horror movie cliches, no shattered glass spiderwebs, no CGI effects.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Critical Faculty: Penjaga Gerbang Bawah Sadar (book-pages.json page 19)
self_reflection_check: Pernah bilang, “gue pasti bisa,” lalu dari dalam diri sendiri muncul suara, “bohong”? Nah, suara yang kedua itu biasanya kita pura-pura nggak dengar.
teaser: Kita baru bilang “aku bisa”, dari dalam sudah ada suara yang menjawab, “Jangan bohong.”

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Kamu Wayang Sekaligus Dalangnya
side_a_text: Kamu menangis tersedu-sedu menonton lakon hidupmu, sampai lupa kamulah dalang yang menulis jalan ceritanya sendiri.
visual_concept: Pelataran pendopo rumah Jawa saat malam hari; seorang pria duduk di belakang kain kelir putih tipis memegang gagang tanduk kerbau wayang kulit, memperlihatkan siluet wayang sekaligus bayangan jari tangannya sendiri yang menyatu mengendalikan lakon.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian man seen from behind the translucent white cotton screen of a traditional wayang theater * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A silent open-sided Javanese pendopo hall at night, stone floor, carved wooden pillars in background darkness * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Holding a leather wayang puppet rod with steady contemplative intention, realizing the movement on the screen originates from his own hand * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The warm shadow cast onto the cloth screen reveals both the silhouette of the puppet and the intricate shadow of his own controlling fingers interlocked as one * [LIGHTING] Warm flickering glow of an authentic traditional oil lamp (blencong) from above, casting long amber shadows against the deep night * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Hand-woven off-white cotton fabric screen, carved buffalo-hide leather puppet, polished horn rods, aged wood grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, the glowing screen dominates the middle and lower portion, dark empty rafters in upper frame for negative space * [STYLE] Fine-art cultural Indonesian photography, rich sepia and charcoal tones, amber light against black void, film grain * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no modern stage lights, no crowd, no magical fireballs, no cartoonish rendering, no bright synthetic colors.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Dilema Wayang dan Dalang (book-pages.json page 20)
self_reflection_check: Kalau hidupmu sendiri ada di tanganmu, bagian mana yang masih kamu pegang tapi selama ini kamu bilang, “ya sudah, memang nasib”?
teaser: Ada hal yang memang di luar kuasa kita. Tapi jangan semua kerusakan hidup buru-buru disebut nasib.

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Lima Belas Menit Sebelum Tidur
side_a_text: Sebelum tidur kamu menelan racun keluhan di layar kaca, lalu pagi harinya kamu heran mengapa hidupmu terasa hambar dan pahit.
visual_concept: Kamar tidur bersahaja dengan jendela kayu terbuka sedikit menatap malam; seseorang terbaring di kasur kapuk berseprai katun dalam ambang tidur tenang, sementara ponselnya diletakkan tertelungkup padam di atas meja kecil di sampingnya.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A young Indonesian person lying peacefully on a simple bed, caught in the twilight state between waking and deep sleep * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A quiet humble bedroom in an Indonesian home, plain cream walls, a wooden bedside table, open slatted window revealing night breeze * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Eyes half-closed in deep surrender, breath visibly slowed, completely detaching from the frantic external world * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] On the wooden side table, a smartphone lies face-down completely silent and dark, while a faint natural blue twilight glow washes gently over their relaxed brow * [LIGHTING] Extremely gentle nocturnal illumination, cool deep indigo moonlight filtering through the window balancing a soft amber nightlight glow * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Washed cotton bedsheet folds, rustic kapok mattress texture, aged wood grain, natural soft shadow falloff, fine grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 perspective from bedside, sleeping figure occupying the lower half, upper space dedicated to the soft shadowy wall for editorial typography * [STYLE] Cinematic atmospheric realism, quiet meditative mood, deep nocturnal blues, bone paper cream, warm umber * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no glowing digital icons, no floating dream bubbles, no neon phone glare, no fantasy sparkles.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Jendela Emas Hipnagogik & Hipnopompik (book-pages.json page 21)
self_reflection_check: Lima belas menit sebelum tidur, biasanya yang kamu bawa ke kasur apa? Badanmu sudah rebah, tapi urusan seharian masih ramai.
teaser: Saat penjaga gerbang mulai mengantuk, apa yang terakhir kamu masukkan ke dalam pikiran?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Keheningan di Balik Pintu Kamar Mandi
side_a_text: Kamu mencari keriuhan dunia di setiap sudut ruangan, hanya karena kamu takut sendirian berjumpa dengan dirimu sendiri.
visual_concept: Sudut kamar mandi sederhana rumah Indonesia dengan lantai semen plesteran basah; seorang pria duduk terdiam bersandar pada lututnya dalam keheningan total tanpa gawai, disinari seberkas cahaya fajar yang menembus roster bata.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A contemplative solitary Indonesian man sitting quietly on a clean closed toilet seat in a modest home bathroom, leaning forward with elbows on knees * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] An authentic minimalist Indonesian bathroom, polished grey cement floor with subtle damp patches, rustic brick roster ventilation, a simple ceramic tiled wall * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Resting his chin on folded hands in genuine uninterrupted silence, completely devoid of digital distractions, absorbing quiet biological stillness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] Through the geometric brick vent above, a crisp beam of morning sunlight cuts through floating dust motes, illuminating clear undisturbed water in a clay pot * [LIGHTING] Natural directional morning ray cutting through deep damp shadows, creating high contrast between cool grey concrete and golden dust rays * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Wet cement floor sheen, matte ceramic tiles, terracotta brick roster, coarse towel hanging on hook, analog 35mm film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 vertical view, seated figure in bottom third, strong vertical beam of light and textured wall filling upper two-thirds negative space * [STYLE] Authentic Indonesian slice-of-life documentary, grounded realism, neutral concrete greys, terracotta accents, deep moss green * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no gross or grotesque toilet elements, no comedic caricature, no glowing mobile screens, no oversaturated colors.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Momen Saat BAB di Toilet yang Hening (book-pages.json page 22)
self_reflection_check: Masuk kamar mandi cuma sebentar, HP tetap ikut. Kalau sunyi dua menit saja sudah bikin gelisah, sebenarnya kita takut sunyi atau takut ketemu isi kepala sendiri?
teaser: Kita masuk kamar mandi membawa HP. Kalau sunyi sebentar saja terasa berat, sebenarnya kita sedang lari dari apa?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Amarah yang Bisa Berubah Menjadi Doa
side_a_text: Amarah yang meledak bisa menjadi api neraka atau menjadi doa suci. Yang membedakan hanyalah ke mana kamu mengalirkan getarannya.
visual_concept: Dapur tradisional Jawa berdinding bata jelaga; seorang ibu paruh baya berdiri di samping tungku tanah liat, kedua tangannya terkatup menahan getaran dada, menyulap letupan amarah murni menjadi sumpah doa luhur yang menggetarkan batin.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A mature Indonesian mother wearing an indigo batik sarong and simple dark kebaya, standing in an ancestral kitchen * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A rustic traditional kitchen with a clay wood-burning stove (luweng), soot-darkened brick walls, dried herbs hanging from wooden rafters * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Clenching her trembling hands over her heart, converting an overwhelming burst of intense fury into fierce, tear-streaked devotional prayer * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] A clay pot on the stove gently releasing glowing embers and aromatic vapor, where a few scattered grains of coarse river sand rest on the rim without ruining the simmering broth * [LIGHTING] Warm dramatic firelight radiating from the hearth embers beneath, casting fierce sculptural highlights onto her weathered, resolute facial features * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Rough terracotta stove clay, blackened iron wok, handwoven cotton batik, wood smoke haze, gritty 35mm film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 composition, mother framed at medium distance, upper portion filled with atmospheric wood smoke and dark wooden rafters for typography * [STYLE] Powerful narrative documentary realism, Rembrandt-like chiaroscuro lighting, deep earthen umber, terracotta ember orange, soot black * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no magical glowing beams, no floating spirits, no cheesy melodrama, no fantasy CGI.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Energy in Motion: Emosi Intens Menjebol Bawah Sadar (book-pages.json page 23)
self_reflection_check: Pernah marah, ngomong keras, lalu setelahnya berharap kalimat tadi bisa dimasukkan lagi ke mulut? Kadang satu detik diam memang lebih murah daripada penyesalan.
teaser: Ada kalimat yang kalau keluar bisa melukai. Ada juga amarah yang, kalau ditahan sebentar, bisa berubah arah.

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Tubuhmu Tujuh Puluh Dua Persen Cairan
side_a_text: Sebagian besar ragamu adalah air yang mendengar setiap keluhanmu. Jangan salahkan takdir jika darahmu mengalirkan racun yang kamu bisikkan sendiri.
visual_concept: Sepasang tangan bersahaja menuangkan air jernih dari kendi gerabah tanah liat ke mangkuk keramik putih di atas meja kayu beranda; tetesan air membentuk riak melingkar yang jernih dan tenang tanpa keruh sedikit pun.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] Close-up of weathered Indonesian hands carefully pouring clear water from an unglazed terracotta pitcher (kendi) into a simple ceramic bowl * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] An open veranda of a traditional house in Bantul Yogyakarta, morning humidity, aged teak wood surface * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Slow, deliberate pouring action imbued with reverence and mindfulness, treating water as living sacred tissue * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The water in the bowl settles into concentric, perfectly balanced micro-ripples that mirror the intricate cellular geometry of living biology * [LIGHTING] Soft diffused morning daylight skimming across the surface of the water, catching crystalline highlights on each droplet * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Porous red terracotta clay, cool water transparency, fine ceramic glaze, raw teak grain with deep grooves, analog film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 macro perspective, bowl and pouring pitcher centered in the lower half, clean dark-toned veranda background in upper half for text * [STYLE] Minimalist contemplative still life photography, earthy Japanese-Javanese aesthetic, terracotta russet, pure water clarity, charcoal grey * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no floating pseudo-scientific diagrams, no cartoon crystal shapes, no neon glow, no laboratory beakers.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Repetisi, Neuroplastisitas & Memori Kristal Air (H2O) (book-pages.json page 24)
self_reflection_check: Coba lihat wajahmu sendiri di cermin. Kalau sedang gagal atau sial, yang paling sering ngomong kasar ke kamu itu siapa? Orang lain, atau malah kamu sendiri?
teaser: Kalau tubuh adalah wadah, kata-kata apa yang setiap hari kita tuangkan ke dalamnya?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Ritual Sederhana untuk Menembus Ragu
side_a_text: Batu akik dan jimat tidak punya kesaktian apa pun. Yang sakti adalah kepolosan batinmu yang akhirnya berani berhenti meragu.
visual_concept: Jalanan aspal pinggiran kota Jawa sore hari; seorang anak laki-laki berdiri di samping sepeda tua ayahnya, memegang dompet kulit usang dan meniupnya dengan kepasrahan mutlak, sementara di kejauhan mobil pengantin melintas perlahan.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A nostalgic scene of an 8-year-old Indonesian boy standing beside his father and an old steel bicycle on a roadside * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] An asphalt road on the outskirts of a rural Javanese town in the late 1990s, rain trees lining the road, golden late-afternoon dust * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] The boy holds an old brown leather wallet open with both hands and blows gently into it with total, innocent reverence and complete trust in his father * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] In the softly blurred background distance, an antique black wedding car adorned with white frangipani garlands passes quietly down the sunlit lane * [LIGHTING] Warm golden hour backlight filtering through dust motes, rim lighting the boy's profile and the gentle breath rising from his lips * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Scuffed vintage leather wallet, weathered steel bicycle frame, linen school uniform shirt, coarse asphalt, warm 35mm film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 portrait composition, father and son in lower middle frame, expansive golden tree canopy and soft sky above for editorial text * [STYLE] Nostalgic cinematic realism reminiscent of Indonesian arthouse cinema, warm golden amber, faded leather brown, muted olive green * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no floating gold coins, no sparkles coming out of the wallet, no magical fantasy fairy dust, no cartoonish exaggeration.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Figur Otoritas & Kuasa Efek Plasebo (book-pages.json page 25)
self_reflection_check: Waktu kecil sedikit-sedikit percaya. Sekarang sedikit-sedikit kita bilang, “Ah, masa?” Kapan sebenarnya kita mulai begitu?
teaser: Anak kecil percaya kepada ayahnya tanpa menghitung dulu. Kapan kita mulai kehilangan cara percaya seperti itu?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Zikir yang Sampai ke Ulu Hati
side_a_text: Untuk apa mengejar ribuan hitungan tasbih di jemari, jika hatimu masih tertidur lelap di tengah pasar duniawi?
visual_concept: Sudut langgar kayu jati tua di pedesaan malam hari; seorang pria duduk bersimpuh di atas tikar pandan, kedua telapak tangannya menangkup di dada menunduk khusyuk dalam keheningan doa bahasa ibu yang jujur dan menyayat kalbu.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] A solitary Javanese man sitting cross-legged in heartfelt prayer, hands resting gently open against his chest * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Corner of an old wooden prayer room (langgar) in a rural Javanese village at night, woven pandan mat on dark teak timber floor * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Head bowed in profound vulnerability and intimate confession, a single tear catching the light, whispering raw unscripted words from the depths of his soul * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] Beside his knee, a traditional wooden prayer bead necklace (tasbih) rests completely still on the woven mat, surrendered in silence * [LIGHTING] Single soft amber kerosene lantern glowing from a wooden wall peg, casting long gentle shadows and warm intimate illumination * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Handwoven pandan straw mat, weathered dark teak wood with visible knots, soft cotton sarong fabric, raw emotional texture * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, praying figure anchored in the lower half, warm dark wooden planks and soft empty space in upper frame for typography * [STYLE] Deeply spiritual and intimate documentary portrait, muted earthy palette, charcoal black, warm lantern amber, raw bamboo ochre * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no glowing holy auras, no floating arabic calligraphy, no dramatic angel wings, no fantasy effects.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Kekuatan Zikir Bahasa Ibu vs Hafalan Bibir (book-pages.json page 26)
self_reflection_check: Mulut sedang menghitung zikir, pikiran malah sudah jalan-jalan ke mana-mana. Pernah begitu? Yang menghitung siapa, yang mendengar siapa?
teaser: Bibir bisa sibuk mengucap, sementara pikiran pergi ke mana-mana. Lalu sebenarnya siapa yang sedang berzikir?

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Sengkuni dan Semar di Dalam Dada
side_a_text: Kamu meratap memohon agar pintu kelimpahan dibuka, sambil kedua tanganmu sendiri menahan gerendelnya sekuat tenaga.
visual_concept: Seorang pengrajin ukir kayu tua duduk di beranda bengkelnya memegang dua potongan kayu pahatan wayang: satu berkarakter runcing tajam (Sengkuni) dan satu berkarakter bulat bersahaja dengan senyum welas asih (Semar).
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An elderly Indonesian artisan holding two distinct carved wooden wayang faces in his weathered hands * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] An open-air woodcarving workshop in rural Java, wood shavings scattered on the clay ground, rustic chisels on a low bench * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Gazing deeply between the two carved faces, contemplating the internal war between calculated paranoia and grounded benevolent peace * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] In his left hand, the sharp hooked nose and suspicious eyes of Sengkuni catch harsh shadow; in his right hand, the plump rounded serene face of Semar catches soft warm light * [LIGHTING] Natural late afternoon sun cutting across the workshop veranda, creating a natural split between harsh geometric shadow and gentle rounded glow * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Chiseled teak wood shavings, calloused artisan hands, weathered raw timber, woven sarong cloth, organic 35mm film grain * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 perspective focusing on the artisan's hands and chest in the lower half, rustic workshop background fading into soft darkness above * [STYLE] Authentic cultural fine-art photography, rich organic earth tones, deep sepia, raw teak amber, charcoal shadow * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No text, no cartoonish comic wayang, no supernatural monster eyes, no fantasy glows, no theatrical neon lights.
source_anchor: Bab 2 > Rasamu Adalah Doamu Sejati & Sanepo Pewayangan (book-pages.json page 27)
self_reflection_check: Dapat kabar baik saja kadang malah curiga. “Jangan-jangan ada maunya.” Kok kita lebih gampang percaya pada kabar buruk daripada kabar baik?
teaser: Ada bagian diri yang selalu curiga. Ada juga yang lebih tenang. Setiap hari keduanya seperti sedang berdebat.

chapter_name: Meretas Pikiran Bawah Sadar & Reprogramming Nasib
title: Lima Belas Menit Pertama Setelah Bangun
side_a_text: Kecurigaan di kepalamu sibuk mereka-reka musuh di luar, padahal musuh yang paling lihai sedang bertahta di dalam pikiranmu sendiri.
visual_concept: Fajar hening di kamar tidur; seorang pria duduk diam di tepi ranjang kayu bertelanjang kaki menyentuh lantai semen dingin, memegang cangkir enamel seng air hangat tanpa menyentuh ponsel pintarnya.
